title: NTU team develops two generations of Transformer learning processor chips for edge AI
html: A National Taiwan University (NTU) team has developed two generations of Transformer learning processor chips over four years, reaching a peak energy efficiency of 157 TOPS/W with its second-generation design, and has taped out a next-generation chip on...
